title: Are We Experiencing The Mall World in Pieces?
content: What if The Mall World is a collective experience we all share, similar to déjà vu? Maybe, in real life, we eventually encounter every part of our personal ‘mall’, whether it’s an airport, a daycare, or a shopping center. I feel like I’ve been seeing pieces of The Mall World appear in real life, almost like whole sections revealing themselves. And that feels significant!
